description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of your website.

> The domain name must be added to your Anti-DDoS instance. Call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。
description.en: The number of the page to return for a paged query.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页包含的记录数量。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

description.zh: ddos高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组id。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-cdn-linkage-rules --resource-group-id default --domain example.aliyundoc.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
